review_notes: Segment 1: Several Sanskrit compounds (e.g., 'सर्वकर्मसंन्यासपूर्वकात्', 'प्राग् दारपरिग्रहात्') were left as in the raw or only minimally normalized; please review these compounds for exact classical sandhi/orthography if precise citation is required.
Segment 1: I normalized 'भगवान भाष्यकार' to 'भगवद्भाष्यकार' presuming reference to the author of the Bhagavadbhasya (a technical term). If the speaker meant a different formulation, please verify.

Segment 1: No changes were made to possible doctrinally sensitive Sanskrit phrases beyond spacing and the 'भगवद्भाष्यकार' correction; if a precise canonical reading is needed, human verification is advised.

Segment 3: वाक्यांश "संस्कृत वालों ने एक चौथाई, पच्चीस परसेंट का।" अधूरा/ट्रंकेट प्रतीत होता है (शायद 'कहा' या 'माना' कहना था)। निश्चित न होते हुए इसे अपरिवर्तित रखा गया; मानव समीक्षक से पुष्टि उपयोगी होगी।
Segment 3: स्पीकर का अंग्रेज़ी-हिंदी कोड-स्विच (उदा. 'अप्लाई', 'व्हाटएवर', 'but') यथावत रखा गया है।

Segment 4: Several Sanskrit compounds and quoted phrases appear uncertain and may be ASR artifacts; please verify against the original audio or canonical sources if needed: 'श्रौतस्मार्तकर्म सहितात् ज्ञानात् मिला कैवल्य प्राप्ति', 'ज्ञापकं च आहो', 'प्रत्यवाय दोष', and the closing fragments 'कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात् त्वम्। कर्मज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।'.

Segment 4: No substantive doctrinal wording was altered; changes are limited to punctuation, spacing, and a minor grammatical case correction. If any of the Sanskrit/verse fragments were intended differently, a human reviewer should confirm exact renderings.

Segment 5: Several Sanskrit/technical phrases appear garbled or uncertain (e.g., 'पर पीड़ा हम नहीं अधमाई', 'इयमपि आशंका न कार्या', 'यावज्जीवादि', 'सर्वासु गीता सुनिश्चितार्थः'). I preserved the original wording where the intended canonical form was unclear to avoid changing doctrinal meaning. Please have a human reviewer verify these phrases against the lecture audio or source text.
Segment 5: I made minimal punctuation adjustments and did not alter sentence sequencing or the speaker's meaning elsewhere, per instructions.

Segment 7: Several Sanskrit/specialized terms were left as in the raw when uncertain. Please review the following for authoritative wording: 'षट्दमशील' (appears in 'भक्ति में षट्दमशील'), 'अशौच्यान् इत्यादिना ... चावेक्ष्य' (the sequence 'चावेक्ष्य' may be misrendered), and 'स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य'.
Segment 7: Confirm whether 'प्रमा' is intended (as used in the lecture) or should be 'प्रमान'/'प्रमाṇa' — I preserved the raw 'प्रमा' because correction could change doctrinal sense.
Segment 7: Validate the choice 'श्रौत्यान्' for 'श्रोत्यांस' — I standardized to a Sanskrit form but original speaker's exact term should be checked.

Segment 8: The phrase 'सांख्ययोगी' was left as in the raw transcript. It may be an ASR artifact or a spoken compound; consider verifying whether the speaker intended 'सांख्य' / 'सांख्याः' or 'सांख्ययोगी'.

Segment 8: The Sanskrit phrase 'मोक्ष साधनानुष्ठान निरूपण लक्षणा' contains forms (e.g., 'लक्षणा') that might require verification against the speaker's intended Sanskrit (possibly 'लक्षणाः' or another form).

Segment 9: The phrase 'जो कर्ता भाव में है, भोक्ता भाव में है, लेकिन अपने को जीव मानता है, देह नहीं मानता' reads as possibly inverted or unclear; left unchanged but please verify against the original audio for intended wording.
Segment 9: I normalized 'व्यापार' to 'व्यवहार' in 'प्रमाण व्यवहार'; please confirm the speaker actually said 'व्यवहार' and not 'व्यापार' or another term.
Segment 9: Sanskrit quotations were lightly normalized for spacing and punctuation; if exact canonical wording is required, cross-check against the verse text.

Segment 11: निम्नलिखित संस्कृत/संकर-फ्रैगमेंट अस्पष्ट हैं — उच्च आत्मीय/दर्शनीय अर्थ बदलने की आशंका होने पर मानव-समीक्षा आवश्यक: 'यस्यां मद्यन्ति बहवो मनुष्याः', 'ये शाम नः अयं आत्मा, अयं लोकः।', और 'प्राक् दारपरिग्रहात्'.
Segment 11: कठिन/संभवतः पाठीय शब्दों (विशेषतः संस्कृत उद्धरणों) के अर्थ-संवेदनशील होने के कारण ऊपर दिए गए अंशों को स्रोत ऑडियो या मूल शास्त्रीय पाठ से मिलान कर मानव-समिक्षा आवश्यक हो सकती है।

changes.original: सो विदान् सम्प्रदाय के... सिद्धांत के अनुसार भगवद्गीता का जो पूरा तात्पर्य है, वो भगवान भाष्यकार ने पहले सामने रखा। (second occurrence later: समुच्चय का खंडन भगवान भाष्यकार क्यों करते हैं?)
